description: What to write and how, in the site's own voice, from the pages that rank and the user's search data. Pick with mode: brief = A content brief from the pages that rank. Needs keyword, competitors. topics = Search Console queries into topics, with the page that owns each, and keyword gaps. Needs rows[{query, page, clicks, impressions, position, url}]. intent = Your page against the search intent of the pages that rank. voice = Learn how the site writes from its best articles. Needs urls. calendar = A dated calendar of refreshes and new pages, steered by what worked here. draft = A draft against the site's voice, sources and SEO, before approval. Needs html.

audit_id.description: Optional: a finished site audit, for internal link suggestions.

competitor_rows.description: Optional keyword gap: competitors' organic keywords (Ahrefs organic-keywords or Semrush domain_organic for each competitor, or Semrush keyword gap rows).

competitors.description: Pages that rank for the term.

html.description: The draft as HTML, title in <title> or <h1>.

keyword.description: The search term the page should rank for.

queries.description: Search Console rows by query and page, for the site-wide check.

rows.description: Search Console rows by query and page.

url.description: Optional: your existing page for this term.

urls.description: The site's own best articles, ones that rank and that the owner likes.

webhook_url.description: Optional https Slack or Discord webhook for a Monday reminder; off stops it.
